description: Download media referenced by a conversation record. Byte streams are written through a temporary file and never interpreted; failures are reported per file and do not fail the archive.
observation_recipe: open a conversation with an uploaded image and record the files download request
open a second conversation with a different attachment and confirm only the id changes
verification_cases: identity: bytes are written to the media path derived from the file id
error body: a JSON error response is treated as a failure, not as media
oversized: a file above the size cap is skipped and recorded in the manifest
auth failure: a 401 refreshes the session once, then reports the file as failed
existing file: a complete media file is skipped without being overwritten
